scope_notes: This stream owns process supervision only; it consumes AppId and launch metadata through the existing package/manifest adapter.
Existing SDK lifecycle events describe app-level lifecycle and graceful callbacks; user/libnagi service::Supervisor manages system services, not application processes.
Existing AppId, AppSessionId, and ExecutionInstanceId types are not redefined. Process handles and supervisor instance IDs remain separate adapter-owned identities.
Capability-principal binding, diagnostics, and process execution are adapter boundaries; this proposal does not invent kernel calls or shared ABI.
